card.name: Cure Mermaid
card.summary: Com a face para cima, ganhe 800 PV.

textEvidence.text: Cure Mermaid activates a mandatory effect once per eligible copy in its controller’s Standby Phase. The source activates in the Monster Zone. Gain 800 LP. The same source must still be in its required zone at resolution, and face-up if on the field. No cost, targeting or other effect.

card.name: St. Joan
card.summary: Fusão de The Forgiving Maiden e Darklord Marie. Sem efeito.

textEvidence.text: St. Joan is a non-Effect Fusion Monster requiring The Forgiving Maiden and Darklord Marie (formerly Marie the Fallen One). One legal substitute may replace one named material but every other material must be correct. A second copy of Marie cannot replace the Maiden. Use Polymerization and the Extra Deck, preserve the owners of materials, and do not consume materials if Polymerization is negated. No other printed effect.
